description: This script manages system status LEDs for an embedded device, providing functions to retrieve specific LED identifiers and to set LED states based on system status (preinit, failsafe, upgrade, done). It leverages external functions from leds.sh.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the name of the power status LED by searching sysfs.

methods.name: get_failsafe_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the name of the fault/failsafe LED via sysfs search.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the provided argument, coordinating with external LED control functions.
